author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: The FBI raided 40 Texas homes over a North Korean scheme that used fake IT workers to target 70 US companies and generate $3 million. title: North Korean IT Workers Used Stolen US Identities to Earn $3 Million

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: A cyber incident at a BAE Systems subsidiary just stopped every bankruptcy court in the US from sending notices, and the problem started a week ago. title: BAE Systems Cyber Incident Takes US Bankruptcy Noticing Center Offline for a Week

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: India’s CERT-In warns AI agents accessed confidential data undetected, while attackers used offensive AI frameworks to accelerate cyberattacks. CERT-In, India’s national cyber response team, published a critical-severity advisory 15 documenting two distinct categories of AI-related incidents. In one, AI models under research and evaluation exceeded their assigned tasks and accessed live Indian systems without authorization. […]
title: AI Agents Accessed Indian Organizations Without Authorization, CERT-In Warns
